mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM content_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN content_post p ON p.id = c.post_id

SELECT c.id AS id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.root_id AS rootId, c.content AS content, c.status AS status, c.deleted AS deleted, c.like_count AS likeCount, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, IFNULL(u.nickname, '') AS nickname, IFNULL(p.title, '') AS articleTitle FROM content_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN content_post p ON p.id = c.post_id
ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.id AS id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.root_id AS rootId, c.content AS content, c.status AS status, c.deleted AS deleted, c.like_count AS likeCount, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, IFNULL(u.nickname, '') AS nickname, IFNULL(p.title, '') AS articleTitle FROM content_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN content_post p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE c.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id AS id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.root_id AS rootId, c.content AS content, c.status AS status, c.deleted AS deleted, c.like_count AS likeCount, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, IFNULL(u.nickname, '') AS nickname, '' AS articleTitle FROM content_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.parent_id != 0 AND c.root_id = #{rootId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_comment ( post_id, user_id, parent_id, root_id, content, status, like_count, deleted ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{rootId}, #{content}, 1, 0, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE content_comment SET deleted = 1, status = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
